The helper is `wouldExceedLimit` in `src/config/plan-limits.ts`. It returns true when `used + requested` is greater than the plan quota. These files call it directly. Files that only use `getPlanLimits`, `getLimit`, or `planAtLeast` are omitted, as are comments and manifest strings that name the helper without calling it.

ANSWER: src/actions/billing/change-plan.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, tests/config/plan-limits.test.ts, tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts
